description: Read up to 50 recent corporate SEC filing index entries by ticker or CIK, optionally filtered by corporate form. No filing text, ownership forms or personal filers. Requires operator-configured SEC_USER_AGENT contact; SEC fair-access pacing applies. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call on Base. Requires an x402-capable wallet client.

company.description: Corporate ticker or numeric CIK; optional CIK prefix.

form.description: Optional corporate form: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 40-F, 6-K, S-1, S-3, 424B2/3/4/5 or DEF 14A; /A amendments accepted.

maxItems.description: Integer from 1 through 50; package tools cap release/dependency metadata.
